catalogue.note: 1.0 full screen. Drawn in Figma at 0.7389 of real size (277.09×600; library instances carry scaleFactor 0.7389): built at 375×812 with every value divided by 0.7389: 24 margins, 56 buttons, 50 radius, type 23/19/18/16/14/11. Square-cornered: the frame’s 12px corners are left off. The status bar and bottom bar are the Android instances (Figma’s export of their vectors); the bottom bar is drawn at 0.75, not 0.7389, and is kept that way. The older status bar underneath is at opacity 0 and keeps its height. The naira sign is not in Satoshi (the files on this Mac hold 431 glyphs, none of them U+20A6) and Figma draws it from a fallback face, the same outline at every weight: it is Figma’s own outline of the glyph, inline, 0.572em wide. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own small scale, so some lines sit up to 1px lower in Figma than in a browser; they are left where the browser puts them. Edges that fall on fractions of a pixel are blurred over two rows by Figma and snapped to one by Chrome. Flat fills match exactly.
